name: clearstack-data-mcp
description: Job openings, Google Ads, Telegram posts and EU VAT checks for AI assistants, via Apify.
long_description: Ask Claude which companies are hiring for a role, what ads a competitor runs on Google, what a public Telegram channel posted this week, or whether an EU VAT number is valid. Each tool runs a ClearStack Data Actor on Apify with your own Apify API token, and every call carries a spending cap. Typical cost: a few cents per question.

tools.name: search_ats_jobs
tools.description: Open roles from company career sites on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and SmartRecruiters (25,787 employers).

tools.name: search_google_ads
tools.description: Ads a company runs on Google, from the public Google Ads Transparency Center.

tools.name: get_telegram_channel_posts
tools.description: Recent posts from public Telegram channels, no Telegram account needed.

tools.name: verify_eu_company
tools.description: EU VAT validation (VIES) and official company registry record.

tools.name: get_run_results
tools.description: Finish a search whose Apify run was still going.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Your Apify API token, from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Calls are billed to this Apify account.
